name: PixelGS Densification Criteria
definition: A densification criteria that modifies the gradient-based densification to be related to the number of pixels each Gaussian influences and scales the gradient by depth to encourage densification in background regions.
summary: PixelGS Densification Criteria modifies 3D Gaussian Splatting by scaling gradients with pixel count and depth to boost background detail and rendering quality, at the cost of higher primitive counts.
